title: One-sheet: Surge scenario capacity mockup
content:
Snapshot / working sheet for a rapid customer-driven surge scenario (mock numbers). Purpose: give SRE + Product a quick sense of which routes need immediate burst capacity, which have cheap fallbacks, and an Owner + next-step for a tiny runbook.

Quick notes (informal):
- Assumptions: peak window = 10m sustained, 3x baseline QPS; average tokens per request = 150; tail lat target 95p < 600ms.
- Cost math here is intentionally coarse — we want order-of-magnitude tradeoffs not invoice-accurate numbers.
- Unresolved: exact billing bucket for dedicated pools (ask infra-sales). Also need to confirm whether KV cache persists across model fallback (affects cost).
- Slack thread: #prod-ops > thread ts 16803021 for initial ask.
- Owner asks: Miguel to sanity-check admission policy; Priya to confirm model availability in EU region.

Calculation snippets (hand-wavy):
- qps -> tokens/sec = qps * tokens/request * avg_token_cost_factor (placeholder).
- If we throttle to 300/s vs allow 900/s, cost delta ~ 2.7x but latency SLO risk decreases.

This sheet contains a tiny route-level mock and immediate actions (below table). Keep it lightweight; copy to a formal playbook only if we need persistent runbook items.
sheet_rows: chat.generate,420,8000,token_bucket(500/s,burst=1000),redwood-small-quant,Miguel Torres,6,KV cache warm required; latency-sensitive,Confirm burst quota and enable lightweight batching rule
embeddings.bulk,120,1200,queue-with-timeout(2s),emb-small-quant,Priya Nair,4,large payloads - chunking recommended,Validate chunking lib and shard limits
chat.summarize,85,600,steady-state(100/s),redwood-tiny-quant,Samir Banerjee,3,can land on CPU fallback if needed,Add canary to eu-west and test fallback behavior
rerank.topk,45,250,priority-queue(50/s),rerank-approx,Alex Huang,2,non-blocking for UX,Confirm index shard counts and cold-start perf
admin.analytics,12,40,passthrough(low),none,Product Ops,1,internal only,No action unless external customers request higher throughput
immediate_actions: Miguel: confirm burst quota with infra (JIRA-RT-9843) by 2029-03-07
Priya: validate model availability in eu-west and report latency delta by 2029-03-06
Samir: run 10m synthetic with KV warm/cold scenarios and paste logs here
Product Ops: prepare 1-page customer note (if surge persists >2h)
